decisions.reason: As a new handle family within the firm's core range, it is cheap to keep as a catalog option and there is not yet enough evidence after one year to justify abandonment.
The mitred handle family extends the design portfolio for architects and planners, so real-options logic favors keeping it while market acceptance is still being learned.

A multifunctional handle is somewhat more specialized and therefore a bit riskier, but it fits the firm's accessibility and system-solution direction and should remain on the market until demand becomes clearer.
This door lever handle line sits close to the firm's established competencies and likely shares production and certification resources, making continued market presence relatively low cost.
Its dedicated presentation and the 2023 German Design Award are strong positive signals, so the option value is high and the chance of withdrawal is very low.
A finish variant usually has low standalone carrying cost and supports the firm's architecture-oriented specification business, so it is likely to be retained unless demand proves clearly weak.
